name: minibot
longDescription: PySTEM Mini Bot (StickS3 build): two encoder wheels, ball caster, downward line sensor, internal IMU.
longerDescription:
• Wheel diameter: 5.6 cm
  • Wheel spacing: 10 cm
  • Port A: left wheel
  • Port B: right wheel
  • Port C (in1): line sensor
  • in2: gyro
_comment: Dimensions measured from the Onshape assembly. GEARS body frame: x right, y up, z forward, cm. The box is the physics body (narrower than the real chassis so the wheels clear it: track = bodyWidth + wheelWidth + 2*wheelToBodyOffset = 10.0); the Onshape mesh (modelURL) is drawn over it.

components._comment: Real sensor sits 1 cm above the floor, but GEARS's sensor body is a 2x2x3 cm physics box pointing down; centred 1.8 cm up so it clears the ground instead of lifting the front wheels.
